scan_result: Turner's 1965 supplement is subscriber-only and copyrighted. It covers several manuscript witnesses already handled in part elsewhere. For example, Berlin P.13932/TM61566 preserves Misoumenos III 132–144(?) and 160–172 and supplies 600-dpi viewing, but Berlin's terms allow study and prohibit direct publication; British Library Papyrus 3077 covers lines 101–466 but has no verified public-reuse licence. Thus neither is an acquisition candidate here.
